propositions: The deprecated environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the codebase and replaced with a fail-loud tombstone that raises RemovedInputError when the variable is still set

The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model and all alternative resolution paths (CLI override -c llm.model, per-step workflow model: override, per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL) must remain functional after removal
All references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL in source code, tests, documentation, and operator-facing material must be eliminated or updated to reflect the removal
The model resolution precedence must shift from env > config > default to CLI > config > default after the env channel is removed
Fifteen test files that currently set REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be retargeted to use surviving configuration channels to avoid RemovedInputError

Auto-generated documentation (docs/env-vars.md) must be regenerated to exclude the removed variable, and all hand-written docs and runbooks must be updated to remove references to the deprecated env var
